explanation: For a learned rank-eight observer containing the first supervised basis vector u0, if u0 dot W2[:,j] is nonzero over rationals for every j, then the gate closure contains every W1 row. A nonzero modular pairing over either prime certifies exact nonzero dyadic pairing. Native W1 rank=128 implies full closure.
limitations: Applies to precisely the recorded binary64 learned projector at each archived model, and to global all-state factorization; does not rule out low-rank approximate quotient on reachable states or nonlinear observations.
